text:
anna-marketing: Quick pre-webinar sync — want to align CTA routing + keyword mapping for the landing post. Can we lock down final KW thermometer and schema snippets by EOD? TL;DR: QA on redirects + internal anchors, and confirm GA tag + form routing.

ben-seo: Quick q — are we prioritizing intent-based KW or product-feature KW for the landing? My vote: intent for ad traffic, feature for blog. For webinar signups we should lean into 'inference cost' and 'latency' phrasing.

chris-growth: @ben-seo intent-led for paid, product-led for organic. For the webinar landing I want to test two CTAs: "Get early access" vs "See latency demo" — different downstream funnels.

dana-analytics: I'll run a 72h simulated CTR lift on both CTAs and the two headline variants. Pushed a sheet (seed + measured CTRs): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 (preview only).

anna-marketing: Added seed KW list to the sheet under tab "thermometer_v2". Also dropped a minimal schema checklist into the doc (json-ld types: Event, FAQ, HowTo). Note: FAQ items are short Q/A that map to the webinar agenda.

ben-seo: Schema checklist looks good. One request: we need canonical + redirect mapping before we publish. Quick example CSV rows to add to redirects file:
```
/source-page,/launch-post,301
/old-webinar,/webinar/production-inference,301
/seed-kw,/webinar/seed-keywords,302
```
I'll run a sweep for orphan anchors after those are added.

emily-ops: Heads up — infra constraint: final slug needs to be <= 64 chars and no non-ASCII. Also prefer hyphenated slugs. Please put the redirect CSV into the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site/pulls (link to PR when created).

dana-analytics: Analytics checklist: make sure form submit fires `webinar_signup` event, and include `cta_variant` label. Also add UTM source mapping for the two CTAs. I'll add a small test plan in the sheet.

webinar-bot: Reminder — Webinar "Production Inference Economics" scheduled Thu 11/2. Draft landing deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar-production-inference (staging).

anna-marketing: Ok team — consolidated action items below:
- @ben-seo: finalize KW groups (intent | mid-funnel | brand) and annotate top 10 for headings
- @chris-growth: prepare A/B CTA copy + two headline variants
- @dana-analytics: simulate CTR, add GA events, add test plan to sheet
- @emily-ops: add redirect CSV to PR, confirm slug and staging URL path length
I will finalise the JSON-LD snippets and internal anchor map (short anchor list for the blog -> webinar flow). Ping in-thread when done :rocket:

ben-seo: On it — will push KW groups by 3pm PST.

chris-growth: Draft CTAs and headlines by EOD. Will include microcopy for both CTAs.

dana-analytics: Running sim now, should have preliminary numbers in the sheet in ~2 hours.

emily-ops: Will open the redirect PR and add tests for slug length.

anna-marketing: Thanks — small note: when you add redirects, include a comment with the source intent (e.g., "intent=cost" or "intent=latency") so we can group redirects by campaign.

ben-seo: Good call — will add an "intent" column in the CSV.

chris-growth: Quick idea — should we include a tiny FAQ accordion on the landing? That helps with SERP snippets. If yes, I can share 3 short Qs that map to schema.

anna-marketing: Yes please — 3 Qs max. I'll fit them into the FAQ json-ld so they show as rich snippets.

webinar-bot: Note: Reminder emails will pull the `cta_variant` property to segment touches. Make sure analytics label matches the email field.

anna-marketing: Awesome. If everyone can mark done in the sheet when tasks complete I will run one final preflight pass before promoting to prod. :white_check_mark:
